_comment: Identity resolution rules (PRD §6, FR-3). Confidence threshold and matching rules live here (inspectable), not hardcoded inline. Auto-merge below the configured threshold is never permitted (PRD Appendix 'does not' list).

exact_email._comment: High confidence, auto-link. Primary email matched exactly (case-insensitive, trimmed). No threshold consulted; exact equality is assumed-confidence 1.0.

exact_phone._comment: High confidence, auto-link. Phone matched after normalization (see normalizers). Exact equality on the normalized value is assumed-confidence 1.0.

fuzzy_name_company._comment: Low confidence, manual review only, NEVER auto-merge. Applied only when no exact email/phone matched. Name and company similarity rank a candidate for the reviewer; the score is never approval to merge. The algorithm is the Python stdlib `difflib.SequenceMatcher.ratio()` over normalized token sequences (no third-party dependency; deterministic and good enough for name-with-typos matching at this scale).
fuzzy_name_company.algorithm: average of difflib.SequenceMatcher.ratio over normalized display-name and company token sequences when both companies are known; name-only is a reviewer suggestion
fuzzy_name_company._confidence_note: The 0.85 threshold ranks candidate strength for review; it does not permit a fuzzy auto-link. Every fuzzy candidate remains pending until a reviewer explicitly chooses merge_into or create_new.

normalizers._comment: Canonicalization applied before matching, in order.
normalizers.phone: strip all non-digit characters, then remove a leading '1' (US country code) if present and length becomes > 10
